name: FHIR Router Mediator
description: OpenHIM mediator that routes a FHIR transaction Bundle by resource type: Patient -> OpenCR (identity), clinical -> SHR. Receives bundles on the /consolidated/fhir channel from the data pipeline and de-dupes entries. Built from its own repo github.com/mherman22/fhir-router-mediator; FHIR_ROUTER_IMAGE defaults to the published image ghcr.io/mherman22/fhir-router-mediator:main.
